title: Authorization bypass prevention
description: Defective starter; make the behavior in task.md true without changing the tests. python3 stdlib; in-memory service.

starter.provenance: Authored for SDKit F05-A (2026-10). No third-party code. The defects are deliberate: see task.md for the required behavior.

requirements.text: Every operation first requires the actor to exist in the directory AND be `active`. Otherwise raise `Unauthenticated`.
A document is visible to its owner, to any user it is shared with (`"read"` or `"write"`), and to users whose directory role is `"admin"`.
`get` of a document the actor cannot see raises `NotFound`, exactly like a missing id. `list` returns only visible documents ordered by id.
`update` is allowed for the owner and for users shared with `"write"`. A user who can see the document but only has `"read"`
`update` may only change `title` and `body`. Any other key in `changes` (`owner_id`, `id`, `shared`, anything else) raises `ValueError`
`share` is allowed for the owner only. Other visible actors get `Forbidden`, invisible ones `NotFound`. `level` must be `"read"` or `"write"`,
`delete` is allowed for the owner and for admins. Everyone else who can see the document gets `Forbidden`, invisible ones `NotFound`.
Rule order for every action on a document: Unauthenticated, then NotFound (invisible/missing), then Forbidden, then ValueError for bad input.
